title: Tipsy Mermaid
meta_description: Tipsy Mermaid offers a private pool \& laid-back 30A vibes---just minutes from the beach, Seaside \& Grayton. Perfect for family fun or relaxation!
description_expanded:
Welcome to Tipsy Mermaid, your coastal escape in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach. This bright, spacious retreat is designed for laid-back luxury and endless fun. Whether you're soaking up the sun by the private pool or enjoying a cocktail in the shaded lounge area, every moment here feels like vacation mode.

Inside, the open-concept living space invites everyone to gather---complete with plush seating, a smart TV, and plenty of natural light. The fully equipped kitchen features stainless-steel appliances, generous counter space, and a round dining table for six---perfect for family meals, game nights, or planning the next day's beach adventures. When you're ready for some friendly competition, board games, yard games, and pool toys are all at your fingertips.

Step outside and you're just moments from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of 30A. Spend your days exploring nearby Grayton Beach State Park, strolling the charming streets of Seaside, or enjoying waterfront dining at local favorites. Tipsy Mermaid offers the ideal balance of relaxation and access to the very best of Florida's Emerald Coast.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pack 'n Play available for guest use.
- Pool heat is a paid feature and must be requested 24-48 hours before the day of check-in.

Parking Details:
- There are 4 uncovered parking spaces available; the garage is not accessible for guest use.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
